findings.F1: In folds B and C, the tested cases fall next day by only a little and unclearly: mean short-direction excess next-day return +0.56 % (t 0.99, 229 cases on 135 days), against the full test's +0.63 % (t 1.37, 341 days). The full test already used every fold and every coin that has data, so there is no more data to add.
findings.F2: The fade sits in the widest days only: below the median range multiple of 1.86 the mean is −0.00 % (t −0.00, 98 cases, 71 days), above it +1.81 % (t 2.60, 98 cases, 60 days); upper minus lower is +1.81 % (Welch t 1.82).
findings.F3: The top width quintile (range 2.3 to 7.9 times the 20-day mean) carries most of it, +2.89 % (t 2.74, 39 cases, 29 days), against −0.08 % to +0.97 % in the four lower quintiles. The width quartiles rise to +1.36 % and +2.32 % (t 2.41) in the top two.
findings.F4: Close location, the grade the tested idea added, does not sort the fade. Close-location quartiles give −0.61 %, +1.31 %, +1.01 %, +0.54 %, with Spearman 0.04. The |forecast| quartiles are not monotone either (−0.47 %, +1.68 %, +1.38 %, −0.35 %), so the plan's forecast mixes a working grade (width) with a non-working one (close location).

ideas.idea: In a falling market, an up day whose high-to-low range is wide compared with the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days is followed by a fall over the next day, the wider that day's range against its 20-day average, the larger the next day's fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader should sell into the widest relief rallies of a downtrend for one day, and not into rallies that are only moderately wide, whatever their close.
ideas.name: falling widest up-day fade

ideas.idea: In a falling, agitated market, an up day whose high-to-low range is wide compared with the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days is followed by a fall over the next day, the wider that day's range against its 20-day average, the larger the next day's fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader should fade wide up days in a downtrend mainly when the coin has been swinging more than usual, where the giveback is largest.
ideas.name: agitated downtrend wide-day fade
